name: Monk's wrap skirt

name: Chest waders
description: Waterproof plastic overalls that rise to the chest, with rubber boots joined on at the feet and a big pocket on the bib.
notes: Laid flat on their back, 620 mm wide across the turned-out boots, 1.6 m from boot heel to brace buckle and 100 mm tall: two tapering olive PVC legs with a gap between them, a bib with a flapped chest pocket, a black wading belt with a buckle at the waist, two black braces running off the top of the bib onto the floor, and black rubber boots lying on their sides with the toes turned out. Slot `legs` is the nearest existing slot, as no slot spans the whole body, and the joined boots mean it should also block the `feet` slot once slots can cover more than one region. `imperviousTo` acid follows the rubber boots. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
